top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Salinas' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.

Road-specific control matters at GFNY Salinas. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 68 miles.
GFNY Salinas' mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Base fitness for GFNY Salinas. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
68 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
At GFNY Salinas, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Salinas. Train it until it feels boring.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what GFNY Salinas' mixed terrain actually does to you.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Salinas. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.weather: March in Salinas, Santa Elena, Ecuador. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Salinas. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for GFNY Salinas' 68 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: GFNY Salinas includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Race Simulation, and Road Specific to prepare you for 68 miles of mixed terrain in Salinas, Santa Elena, Ecuador.
